🧊 Frozen to 2031. Taxed at death.

The Personal Allowance stays frozen at £12,570 until at least April 2031. Pensions fall into inheritance tax from April 2027. Yes there's a £100 council tax payment for bands A-D from January - but a freeze that runs for years costs far more than a one-off sweetener.
